summary: EuroDry Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its press release reporting third-quarter and nine-month 2026 results for the period ended September 30, 2026. Third-quarter net revenues were $19.4 million with net income attributable to controlling shareholders of $6.9 million ($2.43 basic EPS); nine-month net income was $13.7 million. The release also notes roughly $5.8 million used to repurchase 358,130 shares under a $10 million plan extended for a further year, and a ~$37.0 million Kamsarmax newbuilding contract. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms are stated.
